# Initial import report

Built `data/papers.csv` from the 56 curated records in [`data/source/loop_medical_papers_survey_ready.csv`](../data/source/loop_medical_papers_survey_ready.csv), the record table of the survey *Looped Models for Medical Imaging: A Survey of Iterative Architectures, Test-Time Adaptation, and Feedback*. Every row was matched to its manuscript reference number by DOI or arXiv identifier, placed on the Figure 3 leaf that cites it, and given the code link that Supplementary Table S10 reports. Nothing was inferred from keywords, and no record was dropped.

**49** primary records (manuscript: 49) and **7** surveys (manuscript: 7), 56 in total (manuscript: 56). Context-level records (‡): Medical test-time scaling [67], Brain-tumor AL [77], Self-evolving clinical systems [83].

| Semi-CML | [70] | Table S2 marks a follow-up code link, but Table S10 excludes the Semi-CML archive endpoint from the link count; no link is listed here. |

| SDBS-Net | [73] | Authors: curated record lists 'Huaxiang Liu; et al.'; full list from the manuscript bibliography. |
| Iterative Data Refinement | [75] | Family: the source label 'iterative reconstruction' maps to Unrolled/DC in Table S1, but the manuscript assigns this record to data-feedback because its loop refines the training data rather than the image (Section III-A). |
| Interactive MARL | [78] | Table S10: the repository README says code is forthcoming. |
